title: Design a Basic ATM Machine
description: Model ATM states, card authentication, withdrawal, deposit, and balance inquiry.

data.text: Design an ATM that authenticates users with card and PIN, supports withdrawal, deposit, balance inquiry, and prints receipts.
An ATM moves through states: Idle, CardReading, PinValidation, OperationSelection, Processing, and Ejecting. State transitions enforce valid actions only.

data.title: ATM State and Card Reader
Why use a state enum?
data.text: The state enum prevents invalid operations. An ATM cannot process a withdrawal before PIN validation. Encoding states explicitly makes bugs easier to catch at compile time or with assertions.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: State enum encodes valid operation sequences
Card authentication is a separate concern from account operations
Withdraw and Deposit return results for the UI to display
Keep ATM stateless between sessions by resetting on Eject
data.takeaway: ATMs are classic state machines. Explicit states prevent invalid transitions and make the control flow easy to test.
